demo.cliff: a roll lives on the thing that provokes it
teaches: `subType: "toolkit"` is the fifth equipment sub-type, and the one a referee reaches for after `equipment` itself.
`roll {characteristic, skill, difficulty}` puts a ready-made check on the Item, which the sheet offers as a button.
`roll.skill` matches an owned skill Item by name, the same match `requireSkill` and `augment.skill` use.
demo.trap: A toolkit is not an augment: it carries no `augment` block that does anything, and the DM it gives comes from the rules for tools rather than from a stored modifier.

system.description: A hard case of spanners, a meter and a spool of sealing tape. Enough to keep a launch running.
